embed.address_encoding: vm_embed_entry.bank/off/len are derived from each object's ext_addr/length
embed.flags_field: vm_embed_entry.flags bit0 marks macro entries; all other bits are reserved and must be zero
embed.name_field: vm_embed_entry.name is a NUL-terminated runtime string; native registration interns that name

entry_flags.bit0: macro entry; loader registers T_MACRO(BCODE) instead of a function cell

metadata_format.entry_record: u16 name_off, u8 bank, u8 flags, u16 off, u16 len
metadata_format.literal_node_record: u8 kind, u8 reserved, i16 value, u16 first, u16 count, u16 name_off_or_0xffff
metadata_format.string_pool: NUL-terminated UTF-8 strings referenced by name_off

literal_format.entry_fields: lisp65_bytecode_stdlib_entries[].lit_first/lit_count map each code object's littab slots to literal_index nodes
literal_format.materialization: boot loader walks literal_patches, materializes each node, and overwrites the raw host obj word at blob_offset before execution
literal_format.patch_fields: lisp65_bytecode_stdlib_literal_patches[].blob_offset points at each raw 16-bit littab obj word; .node selects the materialized literal node
